https://mastodon.social/@PurpleJillybean.text: Worked on getting Clive Barker's Undying set up tonight since I want to stream it soon. I own it on GOG but wanted to play it on a vintage machine. GOG version on WinXP: doesn't run CD version on WinXP: crashes on startup (seems to only support Win9x, despite coming out in 2001) GOG version on Win7 x86: works So I'll be playing it on my Thinkpad T61 running Win7. I suppose I could try running Win98 or WinME on the XP rig if I really wanted to, but eh. #RetroGaming
